status: preregistered before any live tool-Agent call

model.usage: actual every-turn prompt/completion/cache hit/miss; missing remains unknown

cache.cold: new fixed-length nonce at start of system prompt; no priming; shared schema/prefix hits remain possible
cache.warm: one paid identical initial-request prime with unexecuted tool proposals,then5seconds then identical first request
cache.classification: requested condition is not observed state; inspect actual first-turn and cumulative provider counters

source_update.old_snapshots: unchanged while live; expiry explicitly recorded

outcome.success: actual selected tools + exact independent oracle +5distinct fully inspected current refund citations
outcome.failures: retain every invalid answer/tool denial/limit/context/provider failure; no selective reruns
outcome.context: all source rows remain outside model context; each model request includes actual prior tool responses
outcome.fairness: same tool schemas/prompt/operators/source/policy/budgets; only transport adapter differs
outcome.historical_AB: D20-01 observed A/B20wrong+10context failures retained; not rerun/truncated/reclassified or treated as live Agents
outcome.prior_CD: 30exact evidence reproductions are historical and are not live tool-Agent results

accounting.unknown_reservations: remain fully charged; never reset/reclassify without observed usage
accounting.caveat: conservative upper bound,not invoice; count priming,failed/unknown requests,all model turns/corrective turns

metrics.local_http: actual public request/response body bytes; excludes TLS/headers and internal gateway leg
metrics.local_process: sampled actual Agent+server RSS and measured process CPU; excludes provider compute
metrics.provider: actual usage all requests; no billing/token saving inferred from tool response byte size
